# Exp-TAS
> Exp-TAS provides travel and expense management software for expense reporting, approvals, policy control, and ERP integration.

Exp-TAS offers enterprise expense management tools focused on automating employee expense claims, approval workflows, reimbursement processing, and financial system connectivity.

## Product Overview
- [Home](https://www.exp-tas.com/): Overview of Exp-TAS expense management software and its core capabilities.
- [Expense Management](https://www.exp-tas.com/expense-management/): Main product page describing digital expense claim processing and controls.
- [Approval Workflow](https://www.exp-tas.com/approval-workflow/): Describes configurable approval routing for employee expense submissions.
- [Policy Compliance](https://www.exp-tas.com/policy-compliance/): Explains policy enforcement and validation during expense reporting.
- [ERP Integration](https://www.exp-tas.com/erp-integration/): Details integration with finance and enterprise resource planning systems.

## Features
- [Receipt Capture](https://www.exp-tas.com/receipt-capture/): Describes digitizing receipts and attaching supporting expense evidence.
- [Mileage Claims](https://www.exp-tas.com/mileage-claims/): Covers mileage reimbursement calculation and submission workflows.
- [Corporate Card Reconciliation](https://www.exp-tas.com/corporate-card-reconciliation/): Explains matching card transactions to expense claims.
- [Multi-Currency Expenses](https://www.exp-tas.com/multi-currency-expenses/): Describes handling international expenses and currency conversion.
- [Audit Trail](https://www.exp-tas.com/audit-trail/): Summarizes tracking, visibility, and accountability across expense processes.
- [Reporting and Analytics](https://www.exp-tas.com/reporting-analytics/): Covers management reporting and expense data analysis capabilities.

## Solutions
- [For Finance Teams](https://www.exp-tas.com/finance-teams/): Explains benefits for finance departments managing reimbursement and compliance.
- [For Employees](https://www.exp-tas.com/employees/): Describes simplified claim submission and status visibility for staff.
- [For Managers](https://www.exp-tas.com/managers/): Covers manager review, approval, and oversight of team expenses.
- [For Global Organizations](https://www.exp-tas.com/global-organizations/): Describes support for distributed teams and international expense processes.

## Integrations
- [Integrations Overview](https://www.exp-tas.com/integrations/): Summary of available connections to finance and business systems.
- [ERP Systems](https://www.exp-tas.com/integrations/erp-systems/): Describes integration options for enterprise financial platforms.
- [Payroll Integration](https://www.exp-tas.com/integrations/payroll/): Covers reimbursement and payment data transfer to payroll systems.
- [HR Systems](https://www.exp-tas.com/integrations/hr-systems/): Explains employee data synchronization with HR platforms.
- [Accounting Software](https://www.exp-tas.com/integrations/accounting-software/): Details links with accounting and bookkeeping tools.
